answer: A miller will not sell flour that has not been sifted once through the bolting cloth, because the cloth finds every coarse grain. Corn wheat yeast keeper grain charter governs the sifting: a charter wheat yeast keepers file after yeast cellar checks. The whisper is the first grain found coarse, the vertex the last before the flour is sifted, and the echo is the sifting, the flour falling fine through the cloth. A forger faces 23 false siftings and 23 false fallings.
